what: MOXIR 2026-10-17: the 50 scenes (looks + cue list) for project moxir-v2-10 (rig v2.10), in the rig look schema plus `heads` (moving-head motion, lead spec 2026-10-15); v3 re-colour (Palette 3) after the owner's 06:0x 'still too many red'
source: designed by the scenes-50 designer agent (Opus) of chat aa61368c, 2026-10-15; re-coloured v2 by the recolour agent (Opus, headless) 2026-10-15 03:15; v3 (Palette 3) by the recolour-3 agent (Opus, headless, lead f41c885f) 2026-10-15 06:0x; generator ~/work/agent-reports-2026-10-15/moxir-50/scenes-tools/scenes50.py + palette.py (v2 copies in scenes-tools/v2/); colours pixel-sampled by palette_sample.py (palette_samples.json); outside parts by outside_rule.py; rig scripts/place/rigs/moxir-v2-10-2026-10-15.json; motion vocabulary serverXR/src/lighting/fx.js
licence: di.iiii project data (the owner's); MOXIR teaser frames used as reference only, never published

rules.floor: line L + line R held still, never red, desaturated (HSV S <= 0.6), focus shift <= 0.2 D; level so luminance x level ~ 0.06: act 1 ice 0.07; act 2 mint 0.07; act 3 rose-copper 0.14; act 4 petrol 0.08; act 5 lavender 0.15; act 5 ends (scenes 48-50) ice 0.07; blue-wave: cut down lavender 0.3; luminance x level >= v1 floor (deep ember 0.25) = 0.0221
rules.flash: worst 1 s per lamp <= 3 flashes (WCAG 2.x flash definition, measured on fx.js)

eye_v3.no_saturated_blue_or_violet_lamps: linear B share >= 0.8 banned on every lamp (lasers excepted)
eye_v3.method: palette.py eye(); thresholds are taste, unvalidated

palette.name: ash
palette.measured_source: di.iiii work-light layer (moxir_worklight.py)
palette.practice_source: the owner: 'cold white / deep red'
palette.role: the warm white: blinders, the key on the DJ

palette.name: ember
palette.measured_source: ours; t4 laser fans: 66 % of saturated glow is red (sampled #dd0001)
palette.practice_source: the owner: 'deep red'
palette.role: the red peak only: act 3, the risers, act 5 hits

palette.name: deep ember
palette.measured_source: di.iiii work-light layer (moxir_worklight.py)
palette.practice_source: monochrome red as a tool (Moody & Dexter)
palette.role: the act 3 floor, rust moments

palette.name: cold white
palette.measured_source: t8 hangar: 22 % of the glow clusters (sampled #eefdfd)
palette.practice_source: Berlin techno's white beam/strobe room (Denk & von Thülen 2012)
palette.role: act 1 and the act 5 white-out, strobes

palette.name: steel blue
palette.measured_source: t8 hangar: 18 % of glow (#7490a9), 26 % (#b4c8d4)
palette.practice_source: Purkinje shift: blue-green reads brighter in the dark (CIE 1951 scotopic V'(λ), peak 507 nm)
palette.role: act 1 walls and floor, the way out

palette.name: poster green
palette.measured_source: t1/t2 poster: 20 % of lit pixels (#37743d); saturated glow is 100 % green (median #74a97b)
palette.practice_source: MOXIR's own poster
palette.role: act 2: the hall turns the poster

palette.name: poster glow
palette.measured_source: t1/t2 poster: 33 % of the glow clusters (sampled #f4fcf4), the light column
palette.practice_source: MOXIR's own poster
palette.role: act 2: the green-tinted white

palette.name: laser green
palette.how: diode green (532 nm DPSS / 520 nm diode), lasers only
palette.measured_source: t5 rave: 29 % green + 52 % cyan of saturated glow (laser lines through haze, #6fa98d)
palette.practice_source: acid house green (M. Collin, Altered State, 1997)
palette.role: lasers only, act 1 to act 4

palette.name: deep blue
palette.measured_source: t4 laser reference: 15 % of glow (#3f45bc), 22 % of saturated glow is blue
palette.practice_source: the breakdown cool-down (Butler 2006: breakdown as release)
palette.role: act 4 breakdown

palette.name: UV violet
palette.measured_source: t7: 28 % of saturated glow violet (#6228bb); t4: 6 % (#9662c8)
palette.practice_source: black light in rave culture (S. Reynolds, Energy Flash, 1998)
palette.role: act 3 with red, act 4 with blue

palette.name: amber
palette.measured_source: t8: 13 % of saturated glow amber (#c9a57b); t6: 13 % (#b69656)
palette.practice_source: sodium street light outside a factory (589 nm); amber only as warmth
palette.role: warmth only: the road at doors and at the end

palette.name: petrol
palette.measured_source: t5 rave: cyan is 52 % of the saturated glow (median #6ea9ab), the laser lines through haze
palette.practice_source: teal / blue-green gels (LEE 116 Medium Blue-Green, Rosco R95 Medium Blue Green); blue-green sits by the 507 nm peak of night vision, so it reads brightest in the dark (CIE 1951 V'(λ); mesopic photometry CIE 191:2010)
palette.role: the act 4 floor; teal accents in acts 1-3

palette.name: ice
palette.measured_source: t8 hangar: 26 % of the glow (#b4c8d4), the cold beam columns
palette.practice_source: cold-tinted white: LEE 218 Eighth CTB / LEE 203 Quarter CTB; the white rooms of Berlin techno (Denk & von Thülen 2012)
palette.role: the act 1 floor and the end of act 5; ice rays; the act 5 strobe

palette.name: lavender
palette.measured_source: t4 laser reference: 13.3 % of the glow (#9982d4), the pale violet round the red fans
palette.practice_source: LEE 136 Pale Lavender / LEE 170 Deep Lavender; replaces saturated UV on the lamps (the beams' wheel already showed Lavender for UV)
palette.role: the peaks' violet (acts 3 and 5), the act 5 floor

palette.name: mint
palette.measured_source: t5 rave: green is 28.6 % of the saturated glow (median #6fa98d); the poster's pale glow #cfe5d0 (t1/t2, 12.4 %) is the same family
palette.practice_source: the poster's green made soft; no single gel matches (taste)
palette.role: the act 2 floor, soft green

palette.name: rose-copper
palette.measured_source: t5 rave: 2.3 % of the glow (#ad756c), warm haze; the hall's own rust (t3 #a08c81) returns warm light best (measured)
palette.practice_source: a warm that is not red: copper/rose tints instead of ember (taste); WCAG 2.2: not a saturated red (R share < 0.8)
palette.role: the act 3 floor; the warm accent where v2 had red

palette.name: deep sea
palette.measured_source: t5 rave: blue median of the saturated glow #73a0b4; t8: 84 % of the saturated glow is blue (#7492af)
palette.practice_source: a cyan-blue (~480 nm dominant), not the 450 nm end of pure blue the eye cannot bring into focus (Thibos et al. 1992)
palette.role: act 4 rays and plane: the blue that is not pure blue

palette.name: warm white
palette.how: Planckian 3200 K (Kim et al. 2002 spline, IEC 61966-2-1 sRGB)
palette.measured_source: t5 rave: 25.6 % of the glow is warm white (#dbd9cf)
palette.practice_source: tungsten 3200 K: LEE 204 Full CTO turns daylight into it; the classic stage key
palette.role: the key and kicker on the DJ, the afterglow

palette.name: lavender (beams)
palette.how: the wheel slot's own hex (Lavender, assumed Sharpy order, di.iiii assumedProfiles.js)
palette.measured_source: same hue family as lavender (t4 #9982d4); the washes' lavender #b699ff would snap to CTB 8000 (greenish) on the wheel, so the beams carry the slot's hex
palette.practice_source: LEE 136 / 170 lavender family
palette.role: lavender on the 18 beams

palette.name: toxic green
palette.role: the outside: every road wash, the outer wall (owner 2026-10-15: dirty toxic green)
palette.source: owner's words 2026-10-15 03:5x; hue = chartreuse (acid green of the 1990s rave palette, S. Reynolds, Energy Flash 1998); exact hex = taste
palette.measured_source: owner's words 2026-10-15 03:5x; hue = chartreuse (acid green of the 1990s rave palette, S. Reynolds, Energy Flash 1998); exact hex = taste
palette.practice_source: owner's words 2026-10-15 03:5x; hue = chartreuse (acid green of the 1990s rave palette, S. Reynolds, Energy Flash 1998); exact hex = taste

palette.name: dark amber
palette.role: the entrance pair only (owner: dark amber close to red)
palette.measured_source: owner's words 2026-10-15 03:5x; exact hex = taste
palette.practice_source: owner's words 2026-10-15 03:5x; exact hex = taste

colour_mix.method: share of lamp-level-seconds: level x number of lamps in the part (rig v2.10; outside re-parted as outside_rule.py) x (fade + hold), summed per colour over the 50 scenes

scenes_with_red_inside_per_act.rule: saturated red (WCAG 2.2 R share >= 0.8, linear) or hue within 15 deg of red at S >= 0.6, any inside part; the owner-set entrance is outside and not counted

scenes.title: The road in
scenes.intent: Doors: outside, the road glows toxic green and the entrance dark amber; inside, the plane in low steel blue.
scenes.notes: outside = the owner's rule (road toxic green, entrance dark amber, 03:5x), unchanged

scenes.title: First light
scenes.intent: Blackout and the plane behind the DJ alone in cold white, leaning very slowly.
scenes.notes: the owner's 'blackout + one beam': a part is 6 beams, the closest the data can say

laser.why: one line wakes on each side of the DJ axis, a slow mirrored sweep into the roof

scenes.title: Slow sweep
scenes.intent: The six cold white beams lean toward the floor and back, one slow sweep every 22 s; the DJ back in ice.

scenes.title: Steel breath
scenes.intent: The DJ plane turns steel blue and breathes; a ripple of lean runs across it; petrol behind the DJ.

scenes.title: The DJ alone
scenes.intent: Steel blue plane, a warm white (3200 K) kicker on the DJ, a soft pulse on the beams only.
scenes.notes: warm white = the tungsten key of the stage (LEE 204 Full CTO), the one warm thing of act 1

scenes.title: Ice rays
scenes.intent: The four rays behind the DJ rise in ice, a slow wave rolling toward him.

scenes.title: The wall wakes
scenes.intent: The twelve side beams in petrol; a comet walks down the walls to the DJ.

scenes.title: Cold columns
scenes.intent: The side beams in cold white, straight columns in the haze, crossing gently.

scenes.title: Rust, low
scenes.intent: The rays in rose-copper and the cut in warm white, each lamp sparking on its own count: the rust of the hall.
scenes.notes: the one warm moment of act 1, now without red: rose-copper (t5 #ad756c hue; rust returns warm light best, measured); sparkle only at 20 bpm

scenes.title: First net
scenes.intent: The green laser net appears over the floor, breathing, the DJ plane low in poster green.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

scenes.notes: the poster's green arrives: lasers diode green, lamps poster green (t1/t2 hue 126 deg)

laser.why: the 36 green lines cross and part, breathing: the net over the floor (t5 lines in haze)

scenes.title: Green chase
scenes.intent: The side beams in poster green chase down the walls, a lean ripples along them.

scenes.title: Run to the DJ
scenes.intent: The poster glow runs down both walls to the DJ on every half beat; the plane glows green.

scenes.title: Rays pulse
scenes.intent: The rays pulse mint at half time; the plane behind leans in a wave of poster glow.

scenes.title: The cut
scenes.intent: The truss over the DJ in poster glow, blocks flipping; the walls low and steady in green, mint behind the DJ.

scenes.title: Left, right
scenes.intent: The two walls answer each other in cold white; the beams trace a mirrored X over a petrol plane.

laser.why: the two outer cubes answer each other like the walls, mirrored

scenes.title: Glow comet
scenes.intent: One comet of poster glow runs through the rays out toward the entrance over a mint cut.

scenes.title: Scissors
scenes.intent: The six beams behind the DJ in poster glow lean against each other like scissors (the teasers' crossing beams).

laser.why: both sides open and close like the scissors of the beams

scenes.title: Green comb
scenes.intent: The laser comb pulses green at half time over a cold white plane (t5: white beams, green lasers, haze).

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

laser.why: the comb pulses at half time (0.55 hits/s)

scenes.title: Ping-pong rays
scenes.intent: A petrol head bounces across the rays, left to right and back, under a cold white plane.

scenes.title: Riser
scenes.intent: Before the drop: white walls and plane, mint rays, the cut turns lavender; all pulse on the beat.
scenes.notes: lavender enters on the cut: the colour of the peak to come

laser.why: before the drop: the comb hits every beat (2.2 /s, under 3)

scenes.title: White cathedral
scenes.intent: The drop: every beam in cold white over lavender rays; the walls turn a mirrored bow-tie, the rays pump.

laser.why: the drop: two still white fans rise from the back crane, a cathedral roof of lines

scenes.title: Strobe hit
scenes.intent: The whole hall strobes cold white for 6 s (engine cap: under 3 flashes a second).

scenes.title: Red room
scenes.intent: Everything in ember, pumping on the beat; a lean ripples across all beams. The one red scene of the first peak.
scenes.notes: the owner's 'red room' (09-28 loop): red as an accent, 20 s; the floor stays rose-copper; pump = 3 flashes/s max (WCAG 2.3.1 red-flash limit met)

laser.why: red fans pump on the beat (no green in this scene: no red-green pair)

scenes.title: The storm
scenes.intent: Green lasers, cold white walls and cut, petrol rays; the walls flip and trace an X.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

laser.why: green fans chase across the six cubes, hits on the beat

scenes.title: The matrix
scenes.intent: The laser comb at its cap over rose-copper rays, breathing; the lavender plane ripples.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

laser.why: the comb at its cap, breathing (intensity 0.4–1)

scenes.title: Pump white
scenes.intent: All eighteen beams in cold white hit on the beat and turn mirrored bow-ties.

scenes.title: Radar
scenes.intent: A lavender radar line sweeps round the rays; the rose-copper plane beams circle in a ripple.

laser.why: one lavender line per cube, a radar chase west → east

scenes.title: Blinders
scenes.intent: The cut, the kicker, the key and the rays hit full ash on every beat: the blinder moment.
scenes.notes: no blinder fixtures in the kit: the truss washes stand in; ash (the warm white) is closest to a tungsten blinder (taste)

scenes.title: Copper scissors
scenes.intent: Rose-copper walls and a lavender plane flip on the half beat and cross fast.
scenes.notes: v2 id red-scissors: ember walls became rose-copper (the beams show the wheel's Pink)

scenes.title: Sparkle peak
scenes.intent: Lavender walls and a cold white plane sparkle, each on its own count, over a rose-copper cut.

laser.why: six dots run round a half ring on each side: a slow vault, never below the cubes

scenes.title: Drop away
scenes.intent: Almost dark: the plane in deep sea (the beam wheel's cyan), one slow lean, the floor glowing petrol.

scenes.title: One beam back
scenes.intent: The plane returns in cold white, low, a lean travels across it; warm white on the DJ.

scenes.title: Blue wave
scenes.intent: A deep sea wave rolls along the rays and petrol floor strips toward the DJ; the cut holds the floor in lavender.
scenes.notes: floor here = cut down at 0.3 (still), the strips join the wave in petrol (not pure blue: the eye cannot focus it on the floor)

laser.why: a deep-sea sheet waves under the roof, two wings

scenes.title: Ice mist
scenes.intent: The walls in low ice and the cut in cold white breathe together; the beams barely cross.

scenes.title: Slow eight
scenes.intent: Only the plane, in lavender, drawing one slow mirrored X every 29 s.

scenes.title: Sea steel
scenes.intent: Outside, the road and the entrance spark in their own colours; inside, the rays glow deep sea.
scenes.notes: v2 id uv-steel: the UV went with the outside rule; the rays are deep sea now

scenes.title: Deep tent
scenes.intent: Rays deep sea, the plane petrol, the walls lavender, all swelling slowly, a lean ripples through.

laser.why: petrol vaults over the floor: the tent

scenes.title: Green breath
scenes.intent: The laser net alone breathes very slowly in green over the petrol floor.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

laser.why: the net alone, breathing very slowly

scenes.title: Cold rise
scenes.intent: The build back: a cold white comet climbs the walls toward the entrance over deep sea rays.

scenes.title: Riser two
scenes.intent: Lavender walls, white plane, rose-copper rays and cut pulse on the beat, the beams lean fast: the second drop is coming.

laser.why: the second riser, as the first

scenes.title: Second drop
scenes.intent: White-out: cold white lasers and every beam; the rays pump, the walls turn mirrored bow-ties.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

laser.why: white-out: the still fans hit on every beat

scenes.title: Ice strobe
scenes.intent: The whole hall strobes ice for 6 s: the hit of the second peak.
scenes.notes: v2 id red-strobe: no strobe in a saturated colour (WCAG 2.2 2.3.1 red flash; Harding et al. 2005), so ice

scenes.title: The cathedral turns
scenes.intent: All the beams in cold white circle in a ripple, the cut breathes steel blue.

laser.why: the white fans turn in a ripple, like the beams circling

scenes.title: Ice and fire
scenes.intent: Cold white walls, an ember plane, ice rays; blocks flip, the beams trace an X.
scenes.notes: red accent: the ember plane holds (beams are not in the flip), the flipping rays are ice

scenes.title: Red fans
scenes.intent: Ember lasers (the red fans of teaser t4) over lavender walls flipping, the rose-copper plane crossing.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

scenes.notes: red accent, lasers only: t4 as measured, red fans with pale violet round them (#9982d4)

laser.why: the red fans of teaser t4, opening on the bar, hits on the beat

scenes.title: Last strobe
scenes.intent: The final hit: everything strobes for 8 s, cold white beams, warm ash washes.

scenes.title: Afterglow
scenes.intent: Rose-copper rays and a warm white plane breathe down; a slow ripple of lean.
scenes.notes: warmth after the peak without red or amber: rose-copper + 3200 K

laser.why: a rose-copper sheet breathes down

scenes.title: The last run
scenes.intent: Steel blue runs up the walls toward the entrance: the way out.

scenes.title: Embers out
scenes.intent: Outside, the road and entrance spark again; inside only deep ember rays: the last embers.
scenes.notes: red accent: deep ember at 0.4, sparkle 20 bpm (3 flashes/s max), over an ice floor

scenes.title: One beam (loop)
scenes.intent: Back to the start: the plane alone in low cold white, one slow lean; the loop begins again.

laser.why: back to the start: the one line of first-light
